title: Green in situ ionic liquid-based microextraction for selective determination and operational speciation of Cr(III) and Cr(VI) in environmental and biological samples: a sustainable analytical approach
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SU00274A, Paper
Open Access

Salma Salmasi, Mehdi Hosseini, Ebaa Adnan Azooz
A green in situ ionic liquid microextraction combined with FAAS enables selective operational speciation of Cr(III) and Cr(VI) in environmental and biological samples with high sensitivity and efficiency.
